title: MetroVPN Windows v1.3.3
message: Material 3 Expressive Desktop UI (locked tablet size 1040x720), removed subscription UI, Hotspot LAN Share, full Xray Settings (Strict VCN / TLS Frag / Standard, DNS, MTU, IPv6), independent Material You & Light/Dark themes, Data Quota inspector, Airtel & Mobitel filters, About tab (@MetroVpnPaidProof & @Metrodens_bot), and in-app Auto-Update.
